title: adenandra fragrans
intro: Adenandra fragrans, commonly known as the Cape Jasmine or Cape Jasmine Night-Blooming Flower, is a flowering plant native to the Western Cape region of South Africa. It is known for its delicate, white flowers and sweet fragrance, which are often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Adenandra fragrans include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and alkaloids, that may help to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality.
